diagnostics.message: :resource.helm_release.karpenter: explicit depends_on of :module.karpenter is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class: explicit depends_on of :module.eks is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class: explicit depends_on of :module.karpenter is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.null_resource.update_kubeconfig: explicit depends_on of :module.eks is redundant — already implied by attribute references

resource.helm_release.karpenter lists module.karpenter in depends_on, but it already depends on module.karpenter implicitly through attribute references (module.karpenter.service_account and module.karpenter.queue_name in its values block). The explicit depends_on is a duplicate.

resource.helm_release.karpenter lists data.aws_eks_cluster_auth.cluster in depends_on, but this is already established transitively: helm_release.karpenter depends on module.karpenter, whose own depends_on includes data.aws_eks_cluster_auth.cluster.

null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class lists module.eks in depends_on, but it already depends on module.eks implicitly via its triggers (module.eks.cluster_primary_security_group_id and module.eks.cluster_security_group_id). The explicit depends_on is a duplicate.

null_resource.apply_node_pool lists module.eks in depends_on, but it already depends on module.eks transitively via null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class (which depends on module.eks both implicitly and explicitly) and via helm_release.karpenter (implicit dep on module.eks).

null_resource.apply_node_pool lists null_resource.update_kubeconfig in depends_on, but this is already established transitively via null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class (depends_on null_resource.update_kubeconfig) and helm_release.karpenter (depends_on null_resource.update_kubeconfig), both of which apply_node_pool already depends on.
